verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.fireworks.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) indexing the docs. Docs pages are also served as raw Markdown, and each includes a 'Documentation Index' pointer back to llms.txt for agents, which is consistent with the many .md doc URLs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering (e.g. an llms-full.txt or docs MCP endpoint), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
